business_problem: How could customer service and sales agents like me handle customer objections more effectively and tailor responses based on other agents' past experiences?" The answer was RepsMate—a solution that uses artificial intelligence (AI) and data analysis to help customer service agents understand customer needs and behaviors.
solution_summary: RepsMate used Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure OpenAI Service to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. The technology has enabled customers to halve the size of the supervisory teams, enhance agent efficiency, and elevate customer satisfaction.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Unifies lake, warehouse, analytics, and BI workloads on a single managed data platform.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
